sources.name: tarkov.dev data (json.tarkov.dev)
sources.use: Tasks, objectives, positions, keys, items, traders, barters, crafts, flea levels

caveats: Routes use straight-line distances between selected objectives; check terrain and access requirements.
tarkov.dev marks only a handful of tasks as Kappa (13 of 503 in the 2026-10-20 snapshot), so its Kappa flag is incomplete. Use the wiki for Kappa.
Zone names come from the nearest tarkov.dev map label plus a compass direction, so check them on the map.

extracts.name: Armored Train
extracts.note: Board after the train arrives; it leaves once per raid.
extracts.overrideReason: An empty equipment-requirements cell does not describe the train schedule. The wiki says the train arrives late and departs once.

extracts.name: Exit to Woods
extracts.note: Carry the required item to use this extraction.

extracts.name: Hole in the Wall by the Mountains
Cliff Descent
extracts.note: Bring a Red Rebel and paracord; remove body armor before extracting.

extracts.name: D-2
extracts.note: Turn on bunker power, then press the button beside the D-2 door.
extracts.overrideReason: The wiki requires bunker power and the door button. The snapshot omits extract references; the named D2_LEVER switch identifies the power lever.

extracts.name: Bunker Hermetic Door
extracts.note: Activate the exterior lever; the exit stays active for four minutes.
extracts.overrideReason: The wiki identifies the exterior extraction lever; the snapshot's EXFIL lever is distinct from D2_LEVER and the D-2 gate button.
